about: The case forms of the Ostali borci files (unit 122 and the census parts) that data-extraction/places/resolved.json has keyed: the field as stored -> [GeoNames id, the field with its village in the nominative, 1 if plainly a case]. build_ostali_borci.py writes those files anew, and the gazetteer keys only what the files hold when it runs, so the forms are kept here (scripts/resolved_places.py remember(), run by apply_corrections.py).
